note: In Conejos Canyon, ~12 mi W of Antonito on CO-17, bordered by Rio Grande NF at ~8,400 ft. The Conejos River (premier trout fishery) is ~100 yards behind the campground with full river access, but RV sites are not on the water. Cabins and a small apartment also rented. --Claude
